about_the_game:
An unknown artifact. A forbidden fusion. A race against fate.

When a mysterious Crestal appears in Breezewood, Baron Faustus sees it as a chance to rise in power. But when conflict erupts, the Crestal reacts in an unexpected way: Hanzo and a half-wolf, Rex, are fused into a single being—Hanzorex.

From that moment on, catastrophe follows: mutant creatures, unexplained disasters, creeping terrors… On the run, Faustus seeks to unravel the secrets of the Crestal, unaware that he’s toying with forces far beyond his grasp.

Alongside Alberic, Hanzorex must face the dangers ahead, hunt down Faustus, and uncover a mystery that could upend the balance of the world.

Your journey begins. Will you dare to uncover the truth?

  • Dive into the captivating world of Heir of the Half-Light, a turn-based tactical RPG inspired by the legendary combat system of Octopath Traveler™.

  • Recruit up to 9 heroes with unique abilities and forge a team capable of defying fate.

  • Master the elemental forces of nature to shatter enemy defenses and unleash devastating combos.

  • Face a myriad of enemies, from the darkest beasts to forgotten entities of ancient worlds.

  • Let yourself be carried away by a mesmerizing soundtrack, rich in diverse inspirations, accompanying every moment of triumph… or tragedy.

  • OS *: WindowsR 7/8/8.1/10 (32bit/64bit)

short_description: An unknown artifact is spreading chaos across the world of Farnia. Join Alberic and Hanzorex on their quest to save the kingdom! A fantasy turn-based strategy game. Combat system inspired by Octopath Traveler!
